goal: Raise prompt-effort and handoff checkpoint confidence by sending only known facts and describing each choice in terms of those facts, as measured by replaying recorded fact sets.
constraints: Prompt text, reply text, paths and source never leave the machine.
The handoff check stays shadow-only and a Stop hook never fails.
The printed effort line keeps its plain description.

non_goals.description: Do not change Jev provider calls, decision receipts or the threshold.
Do not change other checkpoints (verify, failure, review, plan, search).

acceptance.criterion: Prompt and handoff checks send known facts and fact-tied criteria, without private text
